name: Honda Grom (2014-2021)
engine: 125 cc air-cooled single, fuel injected, four-speed
intro: The first Grom. Fuel injected, a four-speed box and a huge aftermarket.

L: Most used Groms have been modified. Check for cut wiring, cheap levers and a bad exhaust seal before you set the base tune.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
